name: ribbon
usage: p.ribbon(data: Frame, low: Var | Expr, high: Var | Expr, alpha: Float = 0.3)
description: Band between two variables, as for confidence bands

name: text
usage: p.text(data: Frame, label: Var, size: Float, nudge: List)
description: Text at each point

name: tile
description: Coloured rectangles on an x–y grid; heat maps

name: rug
usage: p.rug(data: Frame, sides: x | y | both = x)
description: Marginal ticks

name: hline
usage: p.hline(data: Frame, at: Float | Var, style: solid | dashed | dotted = dashed)
description: Horizontal reference line at a value or a variable's values

name: vline
usage: p.vline(data: Frame, at: Float | Var, style: solid | dashed | dotted = dashed)
description: Vertical reference line

name: histogram
usage: p.histogram(data: Frame, bins: Int, binwidth: Float)
description: Histogram layer; Freedman–Diaconis bins by default

name: density
usage: p.density(data: Frame, bandwidth: Float, adjust: Float = 1)
description: Kernel density layer; Silverman's bandwidth by default

name: boxplot
description: Box plot layer, one box per x value or group

name: errorbars
usage: p.errorbars(data: Frame, low: Var | Expr, high: Var | Expr, width: Float = 0.3)
description: Error bars from two variables, as coef_plot draws them

name: scale_x
usage: p.scale_x(type: linear | log | sqrt | date = linear, limits: List, breaks: List, labels: List | Str)
description: x scale; a log scale on a value at or below zero is an error naming the rows

name: scale_y
usage: p.scale_y(type: linear | log | sqrt | date = linear, limits: List, breaks: List, labels: List | Str)
description: y scale

name: scale
usage: p.scale(color: List | viridis | okabe_ito, fill: List | viridis | okabe_ito, size: List, shape: List)
description: Non-positional scales; Okabe–Ito for categories and viridis for continuous values by default

name: coord
usage: p.coord(type: cartesian | flip | polar | fixed = cartesian, ratio: Float)
description: Coordinate system

name: facet
usage: p.facet(by: Var | Vars, rows: Var, cols: Var, scales: fixed | free | free_x | free_y = fixed)
description: Small multiples, one panel per group; panels share scales unless told otherwise

name: labels
usage: p.labels(title: Str, subtitle: Str, x: Str, y: Str, color: Str, caption: Str)
description: Titles and axis labels; variable labels are the default axis titles

name: legend
usage: p.legend(position: right | top | bottom | none | direct = right)
description: Legend position; direct labels the series at their ends

name: theme
usage: p.theme(name: journal | minimal | slide = journal, base_size: Float = 9)
description: Theme: white background, major gridlines only, text in points

name: annotate
usage: p.annotate(text: Str, x: Float, y: Float, size: Float)
description: A text annotation at data coordinates

name: smooth
usage: p.smooth(method: lm | loess = loess, fit: Result?, span: Float = 0.75)
description: Fitted line with a confidence band: method: lm by the kernel's least squares with a classical band, loess by stats; fit: m draws a fitted model's predictions and intervals through the result interface, so a robust, clustered or fixed-effects line is exactly the model m prints

name: violin
description: Violin layer: mirrored densities per group

name: aggregate
usage: p.aggregate(fun: mean | median | sum = mean, errorbars: none | se | ci | sd = ci)
description: One summary per group with error bars, computed by the engine's reducers

name: arrange
usage: arrange(plots: List, cols: Int = 1, legend: shared | each = shared)
description: Several plots in one figure, legends collected once

name: computed
description: Each layer's computed data (bins, densities, fitted values) as frames, for a table

name: fetch
usage: fetch(url, params: Record, headers: Record, body: Record, as: json | csv | text | parquet, records: Str, pages: Record, cache: Bool = true)
description: Get data from a web API: the response is cached under its hash, parsed by the import reader for its format, paginated into one frame with pages:, and recorded in the run record; later runs replay the cache; needs network = true in zeff.toml (section 8.6)

name: secret
description: An API key from the system keychain or ~/.zeff/secrets.toml, never from the project; never printed or recorded

name: flatten
description: Turn record columns, from JSON, Parquet or an API response, into dotted columns (section 4.3)
notes: planned for 1.1 (section 8.6); planned for 1.1 with opaque columns

name: rate_limit
description: Limit network requests for the rest of the run

name: dist.tukey
description: Studentized range distribution, for Tukey's honest significant difference

name: factorial_design
usage: factorial_design(factors: Record, replicates: Int = 1, blocks: Int, seed: Int)
description: Run table of a full factorial design, with replicates and blocking; the run order is randomised from the seed

name: fractional_design
usage: fractional_design(factors: Record, resolution: Int, runs: Int, seed: Int)
description: Two-level fractional factorial design of the given resolution or run count, with its alias structure printed

name: response_surface
usage: data.response_surface(y ~ x1 + x2, order: 2, design: ccd | box_behnken)
description: Fit a second-order response surface, find its stationary point and report the canonical analysis; generates the design when asked

name: repeated_anova
usage: data.repeated_anova(y ~ within * between, subject: Var, correction: greenhouse_geisser | huynh_feldt | none = greenhouse_geisser)
description: Repeated-measures ANOVA with sphericity test and corrected degrees of freedom; one row per observation with a subject variable
equivalent: R afex::aov_ez(), ez::ezANOVA(); Stata anova, repeated()

name: tost
usage: data.tost(var, group: Var, bounds: List, paired: Bool = false, level: Float = 0.9)
description: Equivalence test by two one-sided tests against the bounds, with the equivalence confidence interval

name: unnest
description: One row per element of a list column, the other columns repeated; the inverse of aggregating into lists (section 4.3)

name: plot
description: Draw a causal graph in the plot viewer: latent nodes dashed, exposure and outcome marked; node positions are view state, and the scene exports like any plot (section 7.6)
notes: adopted 17 October 2026; drawn by the plot package's renderer

name: matrix
description: A dense Float matrix from nested lists; * between two matrices is the matrix product and elementwise operations are methods (section 4.3)
notes: name reserved in core before the 1.0 freeze; callable from 1.8 with the user estimators

name: vector
description: A dense Float vector from a list (section 4.3)
notes: name reserved in core before the 1.0 freeze; callable from 1.8

name: transpose
description: Transpose of a matrix; there is no ' token (section 4.3)
notes: name reserved in core before the 1.0 freeze; callable from 1.8

name: surv
description: Censored-outcome term for the left of ~, as in surv(time, event) ~ x, with the survival models that take it
notes: arrives with survival analysis (Engine and Project Specification, section 14.1)

name: levene_test
usage: data.levene_test(var, group: Var, center: median | mean = median)
description: Test of equal variances across groups (Brown–Forsythe when centred on the median)

name: bartlett_test
description: Bartlett's test of equal variances; sensitive to non-normality

name: mcnemar_test
description: McNemar's test of paired proportions

name: cochran_q_test
description: Cochran's Q for three or more paired binary measures

name: friedman_test
description: Rank-based test for repeated measures or randomised blocks

name: sign_test
usage: data.sign_test(var, mu: Float = 0) or data.sign_test(a, b)
description: Sign test for a median or for paired differences

name: jarque_bera_test
description: Normality test from skewness and kurtosis

name: durbin_watson
description: Durbin–Watson statistic for first-order autocorrelation of the residuals; needs a time or panel order

name: ljung_box_test
description: Ljung–Box test of autocorrelation in the residuals up to the given lag

name: roc
description: ROC curve and area under it for a binary-outcome fit; plots with the result plot

name: confusion
description: Classification table at a cutoff with sensitivity, specificity and accuracy

name: gini
description: Gini coefficient of a non-negative variable

name: theil
description: Theil index; decomposed within and between groups when group is given

name: atkinson
description: Atkinson inequality index with aversion parameter epsilon

name: herfindahl
description: Herfindahl–Hirschman concentration index of shares or amounts

name: lorenz
description: Lorenz curve as a frame of cumulative population and cumulative share; plots with line

name: rolling
usage: rolling(x, window: Int, f: Fn(List<Float>) -> Float, align: right | center = right)
description: Apply a reducer over a moving window in panel or row order; moving_average is the mean case

name: bland_altman
description: Bland–Altman agreement: mean difference and limits of agreement between two measures; plots with scatter

name: gini
description: Gini coefficient by group as a frame

name: manova
usage: data.manova(vars, ~ a * b, test: pillai | wilks | hotelling | roy = pillai)
description: Multivariate analysis of variance on several outcomes, with the four test statistics and their F approximations; the list-of-outcomes spelling of open decision #2
notes: spelling from open decision #2, option B

name: hotelling_test
usage: data.hotelling_test(vars, group: Var) or data.hotelling_test(vars, mu: List)
description: Hotelling's T² for one multivariate mean or for the difference between two groups

name: box_m_test
description: Box's M test of equal covariance matrices across groups; the assumption behind MANOVA and linear discriminant analysis

name: mardia_test
description: Mardia's test of multivariate normality from multivariate skewness and kurtosis
